_comment: Item 6 debug set on the Classic x5 arm: the classic pilot plus modest per-episode variation -- grasp point +/-2 cm in x, y; retraction within a 20 degree cone of vertical; 1-3 cm at the nominal 4 cm/s. Material drawn from each episode's seed; each concrete draw is saved as mpm_XXXX.config.json. Bite depth 8 mm and 0.5 s close per DECISION_LOG 14.18. Grasp applied as a grid boundary condition (grasp_model grid_bc, DECISION_LOG 14.22), not the 10.7 teleport.
